title: Nora Learns to Focus
moral: Focusing on one task at a time helps you do your best.

scenes.summary: Nora loves learning many things but tries to do everything at once.
scenes.text:
Nora the Horse Who Wanted to Do Everything

In a wide green field, lived a lively horse named Nora.

Nora loved learning new things.

She wanted to run fast, sing songs, paint pictures, and dance too!

But there was one problem…

Nora tried to do everything at once.

scenes.summary: Nora starts multiple activities but cannot complete any of them.
scenes.text:
“I will learn singing today!” Nora said.

But then—

“I also want to paint!”

And then—

“Let’s dance too!”

She started everything…

But finished nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: horse trying many activities at once looking overwhelmed, playful cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Nora feels confused and tired from trying too many things at once.
scenes.text:
Soon, Nora felt tired.

Her painting was half done.

Her song was not ready.

Her dance steps were mixed up.

“I don’t feel good,” she said.

“I can’t do anything properly.”
scenes.image_prompt: tired horse surrounded by unfinished work looking confused, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Lina advises Nora to focus on one task at a time.
scenes.text:
Just then, Lina the Lamb came by.

“Why are you upset?” she asked.

“I tried everything,” Nora said,

“but I couldn’t do any of them well.”

Lina smiled.

“Try one thing at a time,” she said.

Nora thought for a moment.

“Okay,” she said.

“I’ll start with singing.”
scenes.image_prompt: lamb giving advice to horse in field, warm friendly cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Nora focuses on one activity at a time and succeeds.
scenes.text:
She practiced slowly.

Again and again.

Soon, Nora sang a lovely song.

“Wow!” said her friends.

“That was beautiful!”

Nora smiled proudly.

Next, she learned painting.

Then dancing.

One step at a time.

Doing one thing at a time helps you do it well.

Focus brings success.

The End

story:
Nora the Horse Who Wanted to Do Everything

In a wide green field, lived a lively horse named Nora.

Nora loved learning new things.

She wanted to run fast, sing songs, paint pictures, and dance too!

But there was one problem…

Nora tried to do everything at once.

“I will learn singing today!” Nora said.

But then—

“I also want to paint!”

And then—

“Let’s dance too!”

She started everything…

But finished nothing.

Soon, Nora felt tired.

Her painting was half done.

Her song was not ready.

Her dance steps were mixed up.

“I don’t feel good,” she said.

“I can’t do anything properly.”

Just then, Lina the Lamb came by.

“Why are you upset?” she asked.

“I tried everything,” Nora said,

“but I couldn’t do any of them well.”

Lina smiled.

“Try one thing at a time,” she said.

Nora thought for a moment.

“Okay,” she said.

“I’ll start with singing.”

She practiced slowly.

Again and again.

Soon, Nora sang a lovely song.

“Wow!” said her friends.

“That was beautiful!”

Nora smiled proudly.

Next, she learned painting.

Then dancing.

One step at a time.

Doing one thing at a time helps you do it well.

Focus brings success.

The End
